# gyro Provider

Manage Gyro (gyrohosting.com) cloud servers, SSH keys, mail, object storage, DNS records and more through the Gyro Public API. Servers are chosen by plan (e.g. standart-2-4) and region (e.g. eu-de-1).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    gyro = {
      source  = "gyro-hosting/gyro"
      version = "~> 0.3"
    }
  }
}

# Reads GYRO_TOKEN (client API key, wck_...) from the environment.
provider "gyro" {}
```

## Limits

Every account has limits (servers, batch size, paid API operations per day, SSH keys, firewall rules, storage buckets, DNS zones, container plan limits and more).
New accounts can run at most 5 Gyro Cloud Istanbul servers and 1 container environment during their first 7 days.
Read them with the [`gyro_account_limits`](data-sources/account_limits.md) data source (`GET /cloud/account/limits`, `gyro limits`).

**Account limits are raised with a support ticket**: `POST /api/v1/client/tickets` (department 3) or
`gyro ticket create --department-id 3 --subject "Limit increase: <limit_key>" --message "<requested limit and reason>"`.
When an apply is refused because of a limit, the error names the limit, the current value and usage, and prints the ready ticket command.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) API base URL. Defaults to $GYRO_ENDPOINT or https://www.gyrohosting.com/api/v1/client.
- `poll_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between status polls (default 5).
- `poll_timeout_minutes` (Number) Maximum minutes to wait for a server to become ready (default 15).
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Client API key (wck_...). Defaults to $GYRO_TOKEN. Needs Module:Addons/GyroAPI/cloud_read and, for writes, cloud_write / cloud_order / cloud_delete.
